**Install:** download `PhotoLiker-Setup-{version}.exe` below and run it. It installs for your user only (no administrator rights) and needs the
[.NET 10 Desktop Runtime](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dotnet/10.0) (Windows 10/11, x64). Prefer no installer? `PhotoLiker-{version}-win-x64.zip` is the same program to unpack anywhere.

**Update:** already installed? Open the **About** box (the question mark, or F1) and press **Check for updates**.

The program is not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may say *Windows protected your PC* the first time you run the setup: choose *More info*, then *Run anyway*.

`ffmpeg.exe` (for Generate Video) is GPL v3 software by the FFmpeg project; its licence and source are named in `ffmpeg\FFMPEG-NOTICE.txt` in the installed folder.
